content.title: 200/1200 Promotional Public Housing
summary: A 200-home delivery within the wider 1,200-home Sidi Abdallah programme, combining public promotional housing with commercial and professional premises.
Sidi Abdallah integrates public promotional housing within a growing urban hub, featuring R+9 buildings, F3 and F4 apartments, and everyday service spaces.
description: The project focuses on finishing works for a dense housing development, integrating facades, interiors, technical trades, and commercial premises within a larger master programme.
By pairing family housing with professional and retail spaces, the development supports a local economy rather than a purely residential block structure.
content.authority: A public housing delivery where secondary trades, service premises, and R+9 density work together to support a new urban district.
